item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 12/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of the northeast monsoon and its replenishment, temperatures over the coast of southern China will fall progressively in the next couple of days. Besides, a band of clouds will cover the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. It will be rather cool in the morning and at night over the region. It will be cold over the inland areas. With the monsoon moderating slightly and the band of clouds thinning out, it will become fine over southern China early to midweek next week. Daytime temperatures will rise.
